title: Pan-Seared Steak with Garlic Butter
description: A thick steak seared hard in a hot cast-iron pan and basted with garlic, thyme and butter for a deep crust and juicy center.

image.alt: A seared steak sliced to show a pink center, with garlic butter and thyme

steps.text: Season the steak generously with the salt and let it sit at room temperature for {time 30-45 min notimer}. Pat it very dry just before cooking and season with the pepper.
Heat the skillet over high heat until it just starts to smoke, then add the oil. Lay the steak in and sear without moving for {time 3 min}.
Flip and sear the other side for {time 2 min}. Turn the heat to medium and add the butter, garlic and thyme.

Tilt the pan and spoon the foaming butter over the steak continuously, flipping every minute, until it reads {temp 125F internal} for medium-rare or {temp 135F internal} for medium, usually {time 3-6 min}.
Rest the steak on a board for {time 5-10 min}, then slice across the grain and spoon over the garlic butter.

notes: Turn on the extractor fan; a proper sear makes smoke.
USDA guidance for whole cuts of beef is 145°F with a 3-minute rest. Many cooks prefer steak rarer; it’s your choice.
